name: impact
description: Maps merkle diff to affected beads: reads bead metadata, matches changed nodes, classifies actions (create/obsolete).

requirements.title: Read bead metadata
requirements.description: Parse bead metadata from input JSON (sourced via --beads flag or stdin). Extract the mapping record ID from the simplified bead label (spex:<record-id>) and the bead's live status. Pure function over []byte or io.Reader — no subprocess invocation, no live tracker calls.

requirements.title: Match changed nodes to beads
requirements.description: Correlate changed spec nodes (from merkle diff) with existing beads using spec metadata fields.

requirements.title: Classify actions
requirements.description: Determine action for each affected bead: create (added or modified spec nodes) or obsolete (modified or removed spec nodes with existing beads). Modified nodes trigger both obsolete and create. A change with no existing bead is gated by node type before the transition table runs, and api is absent from the bead-producing set: merkle classifies an api change as contract-level (alongside data_flow) so it is not skipped upstream as structural, but the components named in the api's provided_by array already carry the work, so a bead per api would duplicate them. An added or modified api is dropped by that gate; the matched and orphaned paths apply no node-type gate, but they walk bead-map records rather than changes, and an api never acquires a record because no create is ever produced for one. An added, modified or removed api therefore yields zero actions.

requirements.title: Output impact report
requirements.description: Produce a structured JSON impact report listing all affected beads and their classified actions (create or obsolete).

requirements.title: Deterministic matching
requirements.description: Same merkle diff + same bead state always produces the same impact report.

requirements.title: Classify cleanup actions for removed nodes
requirements.description: When a removed spec node has a closed bead (code shipped to main), classify as obsolete + cleanup create. When the bead is open or in_progress (no code shipped), classify as obsolete only.

requirements.title: Validate diff input
requirements.description: Before processing, check if the diff input contains errors (from change completeness validation). If errors are present, refuse to proceed — print errors to stderr and exit non-zero.

requirements.title: Data flow contract bead gating
requirements.description: Produce a create action with node_type=data_flow for every added or modified data_flow change (contract-level impact). Filter test_section changes by the describes array length in the current module spec: len(describes) >= 2 produces a task action, len(describes) == 1 is skipped (bundled into the single described component's feature bead). For every component create action whose spec node appears in a changed data_flow's uses array, add the data_flow's spec_node_id to the component's DepSpecNodeIDs. Emit's TopologicalSorter and Resolver then ensure the data_flow's create op is emitted first and participating components carry ref:op deps on it.

requirements.title: Emit DepSpecNodeIDs per create action
requirements.description: For each create action, collect identity hashes from component uses (direct) and transitive requires_module edges. Attach the collected set as DepSpecNodeIDs on the Action. Bead-ID resolution is NOT done here — it moves to the emit module, whose Resolver classifies each spec_node_id into ref:op / ref:bead / ref:spec_node at emit time. Retires the prior impact-time resolution which pre-resolved to stale bead IDs and drove the broken-dep-graph bug (see proposal 2026-04-18-decouple-spex-from-br).

requirements.title: Accept bead state via --beads file input
requirements.description: ImpactCommand accepts an optional --beads <file> flag. The file contains the JSON array produced by 'br list --json' (or any tracker whose output conforms to the same shape). BeadReader parses the file contents into []BeadSpec. Impact enriches each mapping record with its live bead_status before ActionClassifier runs, so the cleanup-bead gate fires correctly for removed nodes with closed beads. No subprocess invocation — the caller pipes tracker output as a data artifact.

components.name: BeadReader
components.description: Parses bead metadata from input JSON (produced by 'br list --json' or any compatible tracker output). Pure function: takes []byte / io.Reader, returns []BeadSpec. Extracts the mapping record ID from the spex:<record-id> label and the bead's live status. No subprocess invocation.

components.name: NodeMatcher
components.description: Matches changed spec nodes to beads using spec node IDs from the ID-based merkle diff. Correlates by matching spec node IDs against mapping record IDs, not by parsing paths or label conventions. Skips structural-level changes (module.json, project.json, requirement leaves) but forwards contract-level changes (data_flow leaves) to the action classifier so a dedicated data_flow task bead is produced.

components.name: ActionClassifier
components.description: Determines the action (create/obsolete) for each matched or unmatched spec node using the simplified state transition table: added→create, modified→obsolete+create, removed→obsolete. For removed nodes with closed beads (live status from BeadReader), also creates a cleanup bead. For create actions, collects DepSpecNodeIDs from component uses (direct) and transitive requires_module edges — the list of spec_node_ids the created bead will depend on. Bead-ID resolution is NOT performed here; it moves to emit. Gates bead creation by node type: module, component, data_flow, and test_section produce beads; impl_section is always skipped; test_section is additionally gated by its describes array length — if len(describes) == 1 the test is bundled with that component's feature bead, if len(describes) >= 2 a cross-component task bead is produced. Data_flow nodes always produce a task bead.

components.name: ReportGenerator
components.description: Produces the structured JSON impact report from classified actions. Reports two action types: create and obsolete. Create actions include the DepSpecNodeIDs field — identity hashes of spec nodes the created bead depends on, to be resolved to bead refs by emit.

components.name: ImpactCommand
components.description: CLI entry point for spex impact. Reads merkle diff from stdin, validates diff input for errors, accepts optional --beads <file> flag carrying tracker list output (parsed via BeadReader), enriches mapping records with live bead_status, wires NodeMatcher + ActionClassifier + ReportGenerator, outputs the impact report as JSON.

data_flows.name: Impact analysis flow
data_flows.description: Merkle diff + bead metadata → matched pairs → classified actions (create/obsolete) → impact report.

apis.name: spex impact
apis.description: Compute impact of spec changes on beads
